title: Choose where to grow a funnel
objective: Compare traffic, conversion and retention investments with funnel arithmetic and pick the one that fits the numbers.
summary: A branching deck shows a funnel of 10,000 visitors and 150 buyers and lets the learner open three deep dives, buying traffic, fixing the sign-up rate and improving retention, each with its arithmetic and what to measure.

checkpoints.prompt: The sign-up rate rises from 20% to 30% and later rates stay the same. How many buyers do you get?

choices.misconception: Adds the 10-point change to the final count instead of multiplying through the funnel
Thinks a 10-point rise triples the buyers

checkpoints.explanation: 10,000 visitors times 30% gives 3,000 sign-ups, times 30% gives 900 active users, times 25% gives 225 buyers.

checkpoints.prompt: Better retention makes buyers buy again. What does it change?

choices.text: Value per buyer, not the number of buyers

choices.misconception: Thinks retention acts on the top of the funnel

checkpoints.explanation: Retention acts after the purchase: the same buyers spend more over time, while the stages before the purchase keep their numbers.
